class.name: NetwTableHandle
class.brief_description: One replicated table holding rows and packed arrays of column data.
class.description:
Data travels as columns in one message. [NetwSchema] declares the columns and [method Netw.table] opens the table. [codeblock] class Mobs: static var schema := Netw.configure_schema(&"Mob") static var pos := schema.vector3(&"pos") static var hp := schema.u16(&"hp")
@onready var mobs := Netw.table(self, &"Mob") [/codeblock] There is one [NetwTableHandle] per table. Connect [signal received] once and keep the handle in a field.
Each row is identified by a route. Row indices change when rows are added or removed, and routes do not.
[b]Writing[/b] Write the routes and every column, then call [method commit] to apply them with the current tick and send them. [codeblock] func _on_tick() -> void: mobs.write_routes(routes) mobs.write_column(Mobs.pos, positions) mobs.write_column(Mobs.hp, health) mobs.commit() [/codeblock]
[b]Reading[/b] A column comes back as the packed array it was written as, in row order. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: mobs.received.connect(_on_mobs)
func _on_mobs(_tick: int) -> void: var pos: PackedVector3Array = mobs.read_column(Mobs.pos) multimesh.instance_count = pos.size() for row in pos.size(): multimesh.set_instance_transform(row, Transform3D(Basis(), pos[row])) [/codeblock] [method read_births] and [method read_deaths] name the routes the latest commit added and removed, which is useful to keep one node per row. [b]Saving[/b] [method save] stores the committed rows in a [NetwDatabase] under a key, and [method load] replaces the table with them. Routes change between sessions, so give each row a stable id when saving. [codeblock] func save_forest() -> Error: return await mobs.save(db, &"forest", mob_ids).wait()
func load_forest() -> void: var loaded: Dictionary = await mobs.load(db, &"forest").wait() if loaded.error != OK: show_load_error(loaded.error) return if loaded.found: # the row saved as ids[i] now lives at routes[i] rebuild_mob_index(loaded.ids, loaded.routes) [/codeblock]

method.name: commit
method.description: Applies the written routes and columns with the current tick, and sends them from the server. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the rows were applied ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the session this handle names is gone ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the schema is open, the routes or a column were not written since the last commit, or a column's size is not the row count times its stride [/codeblock]

method.name: load
method.description: Replaces every row of the table with the rows saved under [param key] in [param database]. The promise gives a [Dictionary]. Each loaded row gets a new route. On any error the table is left unchanged. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error @GlobalScope.Error. Check it before reading anything else │ ┠╴OK the snapshot was applied, or none is stored │ ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server │ ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the table and the database belong to different │ │ sessions, or the table's schema is not sealed │ ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER key is empty │ ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open │ ┠╴ERR_BUSY a commit landed while the snapshot was read, or the │ │ database is full │ ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED the snapshot is not in this library's format, or │ │ carries a newer storage version than the schema │ ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the snapshot does not match the schema │ ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the database closed while │ │ the snapshot was read │ ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read the snapshot ┠╴detail String what went wrong, for a person to read. Empty when error is OK ┠╴found bool whether a snapshot was stored under the key ┠╴ids PackedStringArray the id each loaded row was saved under ┖╴routes PackedInt64Array the route each loaded row now lives at [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: of
method.description: The table declared under [param name] in [member Node.multiplayer].

method.name: read_births
method.description: The routes added by the latest update. See [method read_routes] for the order of elements.

method.name: read_column
method.description: The packed values stored in [param column]. See [NetwSchema] for the column's storage type and stride.

method.name: read_deaths
method.description: The routes removed by the latest update.

method.name: read_routes
method.description: The routes stored in this table, in row order.

method.name: row_of
method.description: The row holding [param route], or [code]-1[/code] when it is absent.

method.name: rows_of
method.description: The row for each entry in [param routes], preserving input order and returning [code]-1[/code] for each absent route.

method.name: save
method.description: Stores the committed rows under [param key] in [param database]. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [param ids] names each row in the order of [method read_routes]. Values are saved at full precision, ignoring the column's quantizer. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the snapshot was stored ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA an id is empty or repeated, the ids and rows disagree in │ count, or the connection answered no outcome ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER the key is empty, or the schema has a COLUMN_ENTITY column ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the table and the database belong to different sessions, │ or the table's schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 pending operations ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the connection implements no _write_batch, or the │ database closed before the write finished ┖╴backend-defined the backend refused or could not complete the write [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: write_column
method.description: Stages [param data] for [param column]. A column is addressed by the index its [NetwSchema] declaration returned. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the column was staged ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the session this handle names is gone ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the schema is not sealed yet ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA column is out of range, or data's storage type does not match the declared column [/codeblock]

method.name: write_routes
method.description: Stages [param routes] as this table's rows. Every other staged column must hold one element per route, times its stride.

members.member: Whether the session this handle belongs to still exists. Once it is gone, every method returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].
Whether this table's commits are sent reliably. Set it for a table that changes rarely.
The name this table was declared under, which is the name [method Netw.table] takes.
The session's handle for this table.
The tick of the latest commit, or [code]-1[/code] before the first commit.
A hash of this table's schema, sent with its data so peers can detect a schema mismatch.

signal.name: received
signal.description: Emitted when this table is committed locally or receives data from a peer. [param tick] is the tick of the commit.
